messages:
Tess: Heads up 6 Acme asked if we can guarantee <1h private upgrade (in-region) and include an HSM rotation with full audit export. They want options and what we will own.
Diego: Two quick options: (A) Redwood-managed routing cutover (fast, <1h) with paid support and runbook; (B) Customer-managed cutover (we provide tooling + preflight, customer flips peering).
Nina: HSM rotations add friction  auditors want signed approval and an exportable rotation artifact. We should require a staging dry-run for regulated customers.
Arjun: Engineering note: we can pre-stage rotation materials in KMS and reduce active work to a bind/unbind step that takes minutes. Need an approval flag in console to execute final bind.
Tess: Product asks: surface a "managed cutover" SKU on the upgrade page with checkbox, SLA blurb, and pricing line item. Also require completion of preflight checks before enabling the option.
Diego: NetOps will only accept performing BGP/peering changes if we get a validated runbook + rollback triggers + paid engagement. Otherwise we won't touch customer routing.
Nina: Legal: must add liability language and an explicit consent checkbox for Redwood-managed routing. I'll draft clause.
Arjun: SRE: spec automated rollback triggers (error-rate > 3% or 99p latency + request failures) and an emergency revert API. Expose a console button for immediate revert during window.
OpsBot: preflight available -> /preflight-run 1725012345. Suggested gates: ip-reserved, dns-resolves, kms-prestaged, operator-health ok, model-pin locked, kv-cache >= 85%.
Tess: UX: show failing gates inline; block managed-cutover if any gate fails. Offer a recommended remediation list and link to NetOps verification script.
NetOpsBot: runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/managed-cutover-v1 (includes AS-path proof sample & acl checklist).
Diego: Action items: Tess draft console copy + SKU pricing; Arjun spec revert API + thresholds; Nina legal language + staged-hsm rule; NetOpsBot publish verification script; OpsBot wire console gating.
Tess: Thanks all. Sync Friday 9am PT to finalize wording before we surface in the beta console. @Diego @Nina @Arjun please RSVP.
Diego: +1
Nina: +1
Arjun: :thumbsup:
OpsBot: follow-up thread created: 1725012390-managed-cutover-action-items
